doc: A village building, built: its mesh with its moving parts, its conformance and footprint, what collides, and where the player meets it, at the doorway or from the command view.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Conformance radius, metres: the farthest the building or its yard reaches from the origin.

fields.name: footprint_cells
fields.doc: The round footprint that holds it, for plotters that know only those: 7, 19, or 37 cells.

fields.name: footprint_radius
fields.doc: The radius its round footprint must hold, metres.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: The cells it stands on, as q, r pairs (axial, pointy-top, 1 m cells), relative to the cell under the origin.

fields.name: doorway
fields.doc: Where the player stands to use the door, metres, on the ground just outside it.

fields.name: doorway_heading
fields.doc: Which way the door faces, degrees from +Z toward +X.

fields.name: marker
fields.doc: Where the command view puts the building's marker or label: above the roof's middle.

fields.name: bone_w
fields.doc: Weight of bone_b per vertex (0 = all bone_a).

fields.name: colors
fields.doc: Vertex colour, packed RGBA (red in the lowest byte).

fields.name: collision
fields.doc: What collides (design/spine.md, Layer 1): walls, roof, and big yard things solid; the doorway a sensor named doorway. Static for the build, inside the conformance.
